title: Demonstrator Plugin Migration To Crate And Taxonomy Consolidation
description:
Migrate the 🎪️demonstrator plugin from its old multi-crate layout to ONE crate at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🎪️demonstrator/📦️packages/🦀️rust, following the crate-consolidation-and-taxonomy-restructure recipe in ticket 26/08/05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE/📋️TEMPLATE.md — but built DIRECTLY to Shape V2 (the current, correct shape: crate root 📦️lib.rs lives INSIDE 📦️packages/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs, not at the plugin root; no sibling variant files beside 🦀️component.rs — each becomes its own subfolder; data/docs relocate to the plugin owner root, never into 📦️packages). Read TEMPLATE.md in full, including its §14 (Shape V2) and the 2026-08-06 path-prefix-bug correction note (leaf #[path] strings get the ../../ prefix needed to reach the owner-root tree; #[path = "."] grouping-module resets stay EXACTLY "." — do not prefix resets, this is a real bug that has broken several other migrations and is only caught by a REAL compile, not manual inspection).

Demonstrator is special: it bundles 6 OTHER plugins' apps into ONE hot-swappable WASM component (procedural, cad, puzzle, sourcing, process, gis) — this was deliberately saved for LAST in the whole initiative because it depends on all 6 of them, and all 6 are now fully migrated to their own one-crate-per-plugin taxonomy (this is the final unblocked step). Demonstrator's own Cargo.toml/lib.rs currently has interim dependency-only repoints already applied to some of the 6 (check current state — do not assume any prior repoint is stale, verify against each dependency's real current crate structure first). Read each of the 6 dependency plugins' 📦️lib.rs to find the exact current public module paths you need (e.g. `procedural::apps::procedural3d::create_procedural3d_app()`, `cad::artifacts::cad::engine::cad_mesh_from_document`, `puzzle_3d_ui::apps::puzzle3d::{Puzzle3dPlayApp, create_puzzle3d_app, register_puzzle3d_exports}` per the aliases already in demonstrator's Cargo.toml, `sourcing`, `process_3d`, `gis`).

Read the master ticket doc (26/08/05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE/📋️master.md) in full first — it has extensive prior findings (systemic Ok(Emit::…) missing-paren corruption pattern in old ui crates, the temporary-verification-overlay-must-be-deleted-before-handoff lesson, the DEVELOPER_DIR=/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools workaround needed for anything that links, cross-cutting dependent search must grep both Cargo.toml paths AND `use` lines not just crate names, wire-format-diff proof requirements) that will save you from re-discovering already-known issues. Determine demonstrator's own artifact/app taxonomy by reading its actual old code (not by guessing from its name) — it likely mostly re-exports/re-wires the 6 dependency plugins' apps rather than owning much artifact logic itself, but verify this from the code.

Full verification required: cargo check (native + wasm32-wasip2), cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings, cargo test --lib with a wire-format-diff proof if demonstrator has any of its own document/command logic (if it's purely a re-export/bundling shim with no document type of its own, state that explicitly and skip the wire-diff). Never touch root Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock, root 📜️script.ts, the registry generator/its generated output, .vscode/launch.json, .dependency-cruiser.cjs, nx.json, vitest/storybook configs, or AGENTS.md anywhere, or any other plugin directory — end with a registrar handoff block (list of root Cargo.toml member lines to remove/add) instead. This is the LAST plugin in the entire initiative — after this, only demonstrator's registrar step + a final full workspace verification remain to fully close out the plugin fan-out wave. Add all temporary files (baselines, logs, scratch scripts) to this ticket's own folder. Do not close any other ticket.
summary:
Migrated 🎪️demonstrator — the LAST plugin in the crate-consolidation initiative — to one crate at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🎪️demonstrator/📦️packages/🦀️rust, built DIRECTLY to Shape V2. All green except one genuine, newly-surfaced architectural blocker on the wasm component link (details below, full write-up in the ticket's 📋️registrar-handoff.md).

SHAPE / TAXONOMY DECISIONS (derived from reading the old code, not assumed)
Demonstrator was already a single crate (one 117-line 📦️lib.rs + Cargo.toml), not a 7-crate constitutional layout — so there was no union step. Reading the old code confirmed it owns NO document schema, NO command enum, NO diff/op/dsl/pack/spr codec, and NO app of its own: every app it registers belongs to one of six source plugins. So it has ZERO 🗿️artifacts and ZERO 🎛️apps nodes — genuinely absent, not skipped. What it DOES own is the six demonstrator PANES (its own vocabulary: the six playground variants declared in its Cargo.toml, which moved off the source plugins' manifests). Taxonomy is therefore one component folder per pane, named by variant rather than by source plugin, since the variant is demonstrator's own ownership boundary:
  🎪️panes/🦀️component.rs                (bundle assembly: all six register_exports(), then all six register_app(), preserving the pre-migration order exactly)
  🎪️panes/🌱️generator/🦀️component.rs    (procedural3d-play)
  🎪️panes/📐️koordinator/🦀️component.rs  (cad-play, incl. the 3d BRep solid importers/exporters only this pane exposes)
  🎪️panes/🧩️aggregator/🦀️component.rs   (puzzle3d-play, delegates to puzzle's own register_puzzle3d_exports)
  🎪️panes/🗂️aussuchen/🦀️component.rs    (sourcing-curate, document codec only — no geometry)
  🎪️panes/🏭️bearbeiten/🦀️component.rs   (process3d-play — the ONE pane with real demonstrator-owned logic: the JSON↔typed Process3dDocument mesh adapter + the explicit mesh-import refusal)
  🎪️panes/🗺️verfolgen/🦀️component.rs    (gis2d-play)
📦️lib.rs is now 100% wiring: seven #[path] declarations under one `#[path = "."] pub mod panes` grouping module, ending in `plugin_exports!(panes::bundle)` — ZERO fn/impl bodies (the TaxonomyLibShape lint's ideal, well under the 150-line budget). Leaf #[path] strings carry the ../../ climb out of 📦️packages/🦀️rust to the owner root; the single grouping module's `#[path = "."]` reset is left unprefixed per the 2026-08-06 TEMPLATE §14 correction — verified by a REAL compile, not by inspection. Tree purity: the plugin dir contains nothing but 🦀️component.rs leaves, plain folders and 📦️packages. No data dirs, no AGENTS.md/README.md existed to relocate (no collision to flag).

DEPENDENCY VERIFICATION (fresh, against each dep's real current 📦️lib.rs — no reliance on recorded mappings)
Read all six migrated deps' current entry files and grep-verified every symbol's defining file before writing anything: procedural::{apps::procedural3d,artifacts::procedural3d::engine,PROCEDURAL_3D_SCHEMA}, cad::{apps::cad,artifacts::cad::engine,CAD_DOCUMENT_SCHEMA}, puzzle::apps::puzzle3d::{Puzzle3dPlayApp,create_puzzle3d_app,register_puzzle3d_exports}, sourcing::{apps::curate,artifacts::curate::SOURCING_CURATE_SCHEMA}, process::{apps::process3d,artifacts::process3d::{Process3dDocument,PROCESS_3D_SCHEMA,engine::processed_mesh}}, gis::{apps::gis2d,artifacts::gismap::{engine,GIS_MAP_SCHEMA}}. All present and correct. Renamed two legacy dep aliases to match reality (puzzle_3d_ui→puzzle, process_3d→process). Dropped two genuinely dead deps: semio-framework-core (its only use was three redundant cad wrapper fns that just forwarded to cad's engine — inlined the direct engine fn references instead, matching how procedural/gis already do it) and infinite_canvas (its comment justified it as wiring `infinite_canvas::host_asset::register_asset_reader`, a function that no longer exists ANYWHERE in the repo; puzzle already pulls infinite_canvas with identical features, so the feature graph is unchanged). Added `role = "plugin"`, adopted version/edition/rust-version/serde_json workspace inheritance, kept playground variants/brands/aliases/ports and all five asset rows byte-for-byte (launch.json regeneration should be a no-op).

VERIFICATION — all run synchronously, none backgrounded
1. cargo check (native) — clean, ZERO diagnostics attributed to semio-s-plugin-demonstrator.
2. cargo check --target wasm32-wasip2 — clean.
3. cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings — clean, no findings.
4. cargo test --lib — 6/6 pass (baseline was 0: the old crate had no tests at all). Three permanent guards in 🎪️panes/🦀️component.rs (bundle identity; the six app ids in exact registration order; every registered app declares a document schema) plus three on the bearbeiten adapter. One of my first-draft tests FAILED and was correct to fail — it revealed that Process3dDocument deserializes leniently (every field defaults), so a foreign JSON object still replays to a mesh; rewrote both tests to assert the real behaviour rather than weaken them.
5. EQUIVALENCE PROOF (the wire-diff analogue — demonstrator has no wire format of its own, so a command-hex diff would have been fabricated). Instead: temporarily added a [DEBUG] manifest-dump test to BOTH the old crate (with a throwaway workspace overlay) and the new one, and diffed the full serialized PluginBundle manifest — all six apps with every mode/window/panel/action/example definition. Result: 10,949 lines, byte-for-byte IDENTICAL (🧪️bundle-manifest-before.txt vs 🧪️bundle-manifest-after.txt in the ticket folder). Both temporary dump tests removed afterwards.
6. Ticket-local taxonomy audit (🛠️taxonomy-audit.ts, mirrors validateTaxonomyTree + the V2 tree-purity rule, since the real registry check bails on generated-catalog staleness until the registrar regenerates): 7 components on disk, 7 declared, zero findings.
7. Old crate deleted only after 1-6 were green. Temporary [workspace] overlay, cargo-features line, nested target/ and Cargo.lock all removed — `grep -rl "TEMPORARY VERIFICATION OVERLAY"` now shows nothing under 🎪️demonstrator.

🚨 ONE REAL BLOCKER, NOT FIXED HERE (full analysis + recommended fix in 📋️registrar-handoff.md)
`cargo build --target wasm32-wasip2 --profile wasm-release` fails at link: `rust-lld: error: duplicate symbol: semio_plugin_install_bundle` / `semio_plugin_bundle_installer_link_shim`. plugin_exports! (expanded by semio_plugin!) emits those two #[no_mangle] symbols, and the framework declares the matching extern "C" — the contract is exactly ONE expansion per wasm component. This is a STRUCTURAL CONSEQUENCE OF THE CONSOLIDATION ITSELF, not of this migration, and demonstrator is the only crate in the repo that can hit it: I verified against the FIRST committed version of demonstrator's Cargo.toml that pre-consolidation it depended only on the six plugins' per-app *module* crates (-app-*/-engine/-ui), none of which expand plugin_exports!, while each source plugin's expansion lived alone in its 🛂️manifest bundle crate that demonstrator never depended on. Now bundle+modules are one crate, so demonstrator links six expansions plus its own. The registrar's interim per-batch repoints already put demonstrator in this state; it never surfaced because root-workspace cargo has been red throughout. Every possible fix requires editing the six source plugins' Cargo.toml/lib.rs and/or the shared plugin_exports! macro used by ~45 plugins, both outside this ticket's ownership. Recommended (smallest, backward-compatible) fix is spelled out in the handoff: gate the two #[no_mangle] fns on `#[cfg(not(feature = "semio-plugin-embedded"))]` (a macro_rules cfg resolves against the EXPANDING crate, so it is inert for the other 44 plugins), declare that non-default feature in the six source plugins, and enable it from demonstrator's six dep lines — with an explicit warning NOT to reach for --allow-multiple-definition (which definition wins would become link-order dependent).

TWO NEW TOOLING FINDINGS worth adding to TEMPLATE §3 (both documented in the handoff)
a. An isolated overlay workspace whose path deps belong to the ROOT workspace (which every consolidated plugin crate now does, via version.workspace = true) makes cargo parse root's [profile.*] trim-paths WITHOUT honouring root's own cargo-features line — so `cargo -Z trim-paths …` must be passed explicitly. Adding the dep crates as members of the overlay does NOT work ("package … is a member of the wrong workspace").
b. DEVELOPER_DIR=/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools is needed even for plain `cargo check` on this crate (proc-macro build scripts link). Also confirmed python3 is still unusable in this environment.

ENVIRONMENT (not mine, not touched): root cargo is currently red because ✏️s/🔌️plugins/➗️mathematical/📦️packages/🦀️rust/Cargo.toml has a leftover TEMPORARY VERIFICATION OVERLAY [workspace] table while being a registered root member ("multiple workspace roots found"); 🏗️fem has one too but is genuinely in-flight. Also: wasm builds under the plain dev profile die with the known rust-lld SIGSEGV (this time in semio-framework-os-kernel-math-graph-dsl) — same class as root Cargo.toml's existing store codegen-units=1 workaround, unrelated.

REGISTRAR HANDOFF — remove root Cargo.toml member line "✏️s/🔌️plugins/🎪️demonstrator/🛂️manifest/🗿️artifact/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust", add "✏️s/🔌️plugins/🎪️demonstrator/📦️packages/🦀️rust". Nothing to remove from [workspace.dependencies] (demonstrator was never aliased there; a repo-wide grep confirms nothing depends on it — it is a leaf). Then cargo metadata, plugin-registry:generate, launch.json regeneration. Also flagged (doc-comment-only, left for their owners): the "demonstrator row moved to …" comment in each of the six source plugins' Cargo.toml and ♻️mit-bestand/🧺️demonstrator/📜️script.ts:14 still name the deleted old path.

🏁 THIS IS THE LAST PLUGIN IN THE ENTIRE INITIATIVE. With demonstrator done, only its registrar step, the duplicate-symbol decision above, and the final full-workspace verification remain to close out the plugin fan-out wave.
